blockingQuestionsForFormalG1.question: Freeze the exact K facts query contract, including all project contracts and project-or-sourceLead follow-ups with original ordering, ownership and null behavior. A handover-ID-only or empty facts port cannot satisfy this dependency.

Name the exact original database.seeder prepared-state recipe and source hash, every UUID-remapped row/reference and its ownership proof. Native confirm must really execute and produce its final state; mapped fixture rows alone do not certify Rust R4 commands.

Separate the actual K read set from freeze/snapshot provenance observations. Original K does not actively read snapshot/freeze fields in this call chain; do not introduce such reads, a confirmed-only gate or a changed candidate set.
Freeze new permanent S2 before generation, with exact focused inputs and non-author checkpoint review. Keep the original generator six-input guards, old baseline authority and both S/S2 ancestors.

sourceFindings.finding: Original context checks project read/write permission, existing handover, then existing project. It has no confirmed-only status gate.

Candidates come from project, optional sourceLead, all project contracts, project OR sourceLead sales follow-ups and this handover. Active attachments resolve final version first, deduplicate by versionGroup and retain merged sourceRefs. Contract and follow-up query ordering are observable inputs.

Existing selections bypass fresh candidate construction on checklist read. Package creation may refresh when selections are absent; read-authorized outer entry then encounters original write checks. Selection-version checks, exclusions, storage failure state and independent audit ordering need the real Native witness, not an idealized transaction rewrite.
ZIP manifest/sourceRefs and actual original attachment bytes are used; package success cannot be represented by a synthetic ZIP or a URL-only placeholder.

acceptedProducerConsumerBoundary.missingDraftCreationApi: Do not fabricate an absent draft-creation API or call direct prepared-state initialization a migrated Rust producer.
acceptedProducerConsumerBoundary.ownership: Require exact intent-to-create provenance, complete UUID/text/JSON/FK reference closure and preflight before cleanup. Seeded definitions remain read-only unless separately owned. Restore controlled faults; retain failed/incomplete attempts.
acceptedProducerConsumerBoundary.authorization: Reuse original project:read/write checks and existence/error order. Ownership here means fixture and referential provenance, not a new domain-owner authorization gate.

A bounded provenance path through the named prepared-state recipe and actual original Nest confirm, with any optional freeze observed separately; use exact owned facts shared by both implementations.

A source-derived valid draft context where original Nest allows it, so no confirmed-only restriction is introduced. This is a finite compatibility check, not a demand for all status/operation permutations.

Original candidate/source merge, final/history/manual-exclusion/security behavior; relevant selection conflicts, expiry and storage/stream failure stages with residual ownership and cleanup. Freeze a finite case set from actual source and observed uncertainty, not an exhaustive Cartesian matrix.
